zh.headline: 从网络安全出发，持续探索软件工程与人工智能。
zh.intro:
浙江大学软件学院 2026 级软件工程新生。
本科毕业于武汉大学国家网络安全学院，关注深度学习、可信软件与隐私保护。

about.title: 把安全背景带进软件工程，把工程能力带回研究问题。
about.body: 我关注人工智能、软件工程与网络安全的交叉方向，喜欢从论文和真实数据出发提出假设，再用实验和代码验证方法边界。接下来将在浙江大学软件学院继续学习软件工程，探索可信、智能且可维护的软件系统。

Incoming software engineering graduate student at the School of Software Technology, Zhejiang University.
BSc from the School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Wuhan University, working on deep learning, trustworthy software and privacy.

about.title: Bringing a security background into software engineering, and engineering rigour back into research.
about.body: I work where artificial intelligence, software engineering and cyber security overlap. I like starting from papers and real data, forming a hypothesis, then using experiments and code to find where a method actually breaks. Next I continue in software engineering at Zhejiang University, building software systems that are trustworthy, intelligent and maintainable.
